text:
Camille: quick heads-up — we need a brief status rollup for the console observability cutover this week. focusing on dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, and the retention milestone. who owns what and any blockers? :eyes:
Ryan: tracing hooks (SRE) — canary shows missing parent_id on ~12% of traces. looks like header truncation from the edge. PR with tentative fix is up: #3421. still validating on staging.
Priya: dashboards (obs eng) — most widgets done, waiting on the trace join key from Ryan's change to enable the error heatmap. PR #2387 is blocked on that. small frontend tweaks pending review.
Ben: retention & infra — retention target set to 90d for the cutover compliance requirement. cost delta estimate ~+18% for hot storage at current ingest. can propose tiered retention: 90d hot / 365d cold archive if that helps.
Maria: product — confirmed compliance needs 90d. we can accept tiered model if it doesn't push SLA risk. also need error-analysis view to support user-facing SLO drilldowns.
Ryan: @Priya i pushed a quick env change to increase header buffer:```yaml
envoy: 
  admin: 
    max_request_headers_kb: 64
```
testing now, should reduce truncation.
Priya: thanks — once that lands i'll re-run the trace join job and push the dashboard backend migration. ETA: ~3h after canary is green.
Ben: pinging cost-team for a final confirmation on the estimate, cc @Maria for product budget signoff.
deploy-bot: deploy started for svc/edge-proxy tag=fix/header-buffer by Ryan — canary -> 10% -> 50%
Ryan: canary looks stable after 20 minutes, parent_id rate back to 98%. moving to 50%.
Camille: great. can we enumerate owners + immediate action items? I'll collect for the cutover doc.
Priya: owner: dashboards + error-views = Priya (PR #2387). action: re-run trace join after Ryan's change lands.
Ryan: owner: tracing hooks + canary = Ryan (PR #3421). action: monitor canary -> full rollout if stable.
Ben: owner: retention config + infra = Ben. action: finalize tiered retention plan and send cost delta doc by EOD.
Maria: owner: product acceptance = Maria. action: confirm SLO coverage and sign off on tiered plan.
Camille: blockers: (1) trace join dependency, (2) retention cost sign-off, (3) frontend review for error-views. Next steps: Priya will post a comment on #2387 when re-run completes; Ben will post cost doc; Ryan will update rollout status in this thread. If all green, aim for cutover on Friday 10:00 PT.
Ben: noted, will have cost doc by 17:00 PT.
Ryan: will update status here once full rollout completes.
Priya: re-run done, dashboards backend migration queued — tagging reviewers @Camille @Maria.
Camille: thanks all — i'll update the cutover checklist and notify ops. :thumbsup:
